title: Yuu Lantern Ward
body:
# Yuu Lantern Ward

Lantern-powered anti-hostile protection aura.

## Features
- Ward activates when holding or standing near lanterns.
- Nearby hostile mobs get slowed and lose direct aggro.
- Supports both normal and soul lantern blocks/items.
- Configurable search radius, effect strength and tick interval.

## Command
- `/lanternward [status|on|off|reload]`

## Permission
- `yuulanternward.use`

## Compatibility
- Loaders: spigot, paper, purpur
- Game versions: 1.16.5, 1.17.1, 1.18.2, 1.19.4, 1.20.1, 1.20.4, 1.20.6, 1.21.1

## Notes
- Lightweight implementation with configurable behavior in `config.yml`.
- Built by **yuutaxd**.
